definitions.note: One impact the resonance ear kept. It is what the player hears and what the note timeline draws.
definitions.beat: Notes that begin within 80 ms of each other. A ball on the seam between two pieces sounds two notes in one beat. Counts and phrases are in beats.
definitions.phrase: The pieces of each beat, in order. A seam beat is written a+b.
definitions.ledgerOrder: Piece rows of the contact ledger, in order. Consecutive callbacks on one body are one row, so two bounces on one piece are one row and two beats.
definitions.neighbour: One slider step: 0.5° yaw, 0.5° elevation, or 0.01 charge.
definitions.neighbourhood: For each lattice cell with at least `floor` beats and all six neighbours on the lattice: same is an identical phrase; variation is a different phrase that still has at least `floor` beats; thinner has fewer but is not silent; silent has none.
definitions.mixBound: Summed level entering the mix limiter with every partial in phase, on the tuned-even bank voice. An upper bound, not a measured peak.

neighbours.phrase: wall-near-e > ramp-w > wall-near-e > ramp-w > ramp-w > ramp-w
